```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- read_json("data/wildfires.geojson")
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
first_fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(first_fire)
```

```{r}
first_coordinate <- first_fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
first_coordinate
```

```{r}
features_tbl <- tibble(features = raw$features)
features_tbl
```

```{r}
features_wide <- features_tbl |> unnest_wider(features)
features_wide
```

```{r}
properties_wide <- features_wide |> unnest_wider(properties)
properties_wide
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- properties_wide |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |> filter(str_detect(incident, "August"))
nrow(august_fires)

fires |> arrange(desc(gis_acres)) |> slice_head(n = 10)

ggplot(fires, aes(x = gis_acres)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_x_log10()

acres_by_year <- fires |>
  group_by(fire_year) |>
  summarize(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(acres_by_year, aes(x = fire_year, y = total_acres)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Acres Burned by Year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total Acres Burned",
    caption = "Source: Wildfire incident data"
  )

acres_by_state <- fires |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarize(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  slice_max(total_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(state = fct_reorder(state, total_acres))

ggplot(acres_by_state, aes(x = state, y = total_acres)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 States by Total Acres Burned",
    x = "State",
    y = "Total Acres Burned",
    caption = "Source: Wildfire incident data"
  )
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      mean(map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 1))
    }),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      mean(map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 2))
    })
  )

big_fires

big_fires_by_agency <- big_fires |>
  count(agency, name = "number_of_fires")

ggplot(big_fires_by_agency, aes(x = agency, y = number_of_fires)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Big Fires by Managing Agency",
    x = "Managing Agency",
    y = "Number of Big Fires"
  )
```

```{r}
scrape_imdb_snapshot <- function(url, snap_year) {
  page <- request(url) |>
    req_timeout(30) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3, backoff = ~ 2 ^ .x) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  rows <- page |> html_elements("tbody tr")

  tibble(
    snap_year = snap_year,
    rank = seq_along(rows),
    title = rows |> html_element(".titleColumn a") |> html_text2(),
    year = rows |>
      html_element(".titleColumn .secondaryInfo") |>
      html_attr("data-value") |>
      as.integer(),
    rating = rows |>
      html_element(".ratingColumn.imdbRating strong") |>
      html_text2() |>
      as.numeric(),
    number = rows |>
      html_element(".ratingColumn.imdbRating strong") |>
      html_attr("data-value") |>
      as.numeric()
  )
}

snapshot_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101000000/http://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101000000/http://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101000000/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101000000/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220101000000/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)

snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

imdb_snapshots <- map2(snapshot_urls, snapshot_years, scrape_imdb_snapshot) |>
  list_rbind()

imdb_snapshots

imdb_snapshots |>
  count(snap_year)
```

```{r}
rank_changes <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  filter(!is.na(rank_2015), !is.na(rank_2022)) |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015,
    absolute_rank_change = abs(rank_change),
    release_decade = floor(year / 10) * 10
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(absolute_rank_change)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

rank_changes

rank_changes |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change)) |>
  arrange(release_decade)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year, values_from = rank, names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  filter(!is.na(rank_2015), !is.na(rank_2022)) |>
  mutate(
    rank_change = rank_2022 - rank_2015,
    release_decade = floor(year / 10) * 10
  ) |>
  group_by(release_decade) |>
  summarize(average_rank_change = mean(rank_change)) |>
  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      average_rank_change > 0 ~ "Rose",
      average_rank_change < 0 ~ "Fell",
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = average_rank_change,
    y = factor(release_decade),
    fill = direction
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Rose" = "#c44e52", "Fell" = "#4c78a8", "No change" = "gray70")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Average IMDb Rank Change by Release Decade",
    subtitle = "Comparing films that appear in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots",
    x = "Average change in IMDb rank (2015 to 2022)",
    y = "Release decade",
    fill = "Rank direction",
    caption = "Sample size: 183 films appearing in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  )
```

```{r}
nolan_films <- c(
  "The Dark Knight",
  "Inception",
  "Interstellar",
  "The Dark Knight Rises",
  "Memento",
  "The Prestige",
  "Batman Begins"
)

imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(title %in% nolan_films) |>
  select(title, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = snap_year,
    values_from = rank,
    names_glue = "rank_{snap_year}"
  )
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(title == "Interstellar") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(snap_year), y = rank)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(
    title = "Interstellar Rank by Snapshot Year",
    x = "Snapshot Year",
    y = "Rank"
  )
```

```{r}
film_snapshot_counts <- imdb_snapshots |>
  distinct(title, snap_year) |>
  count(title, name = "snapshots_appeared")

film_snapshot_counts |>
  count(snapshots_appeared, name = "number_of_films") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = snapshots_appeared, y = number_of_films)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:5) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Film Appearances Across Snapshots",
    x = "Number of Snapshots Appeared In",
    y = "Number of Films"
  )
```
